title: Count Occurrences
problem: The first line is a positive integer N. The second line holds N integers separated by spaces. The third line holds one integer X. Print how many times X appears in the list. For example, in 1 2 1 3 the number 1 appears 2 times.
starter_code:
# The first line is N, the second line holds N integers,
# the third line holds X.
# Print how many times X appears in the list.

# Write your code here

hints.1: Compare X with each number in the list, one at a time.
hints.2: Turn the second line into a list of integers with map(int, ...), turn X into an integer too, then count the matches with a loop or the list's count() method. Counting X in the raw text of the line would also count it inside longer numbers.

failure_explanation: Compare whole numbers, not pieces of text: searching the line as text also finds X inside longer numbers. Convert both the list and X with int() so negative numbers and zero match correctly.
